decision: 5 second time penalty. 1 penalty point (total of 10 for the 12 month period).
fact: Car 87 made more than one change of direction to defend its position
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 87 was defending its position against Car 18 on the straight prior to Turn 9 and made multiple moves to change direction. This is a breach of the regulations.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 87 More Than One Change Of Direction
to: The Team Manager, MoneyGram Haas F1 Team
